recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed unless a work group separately wants an editorial tutorial for registry searches.
issue_request: FHIR-5822 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking for a way to query across resources, profiles, and extensions to find where a data element is used, including concerns about consistent value set use.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5822. Jira comments show the request was deferred as ontology/definition metadata work and later marked done; git history shows the relevant functionality arrived through broader ElementDefinition and StructureDefinition search infrastructure rather than a keyed issue commit.
additional_context: DataElement is no longer an active resource in source/fhir.ini, while StructureDefinition is active and is the current resource used to define resources, data types, extensions, and profiles. StructureDefinition metadata and search parameters support lookup by constrained element path, base path, type, context, and value set, and the spec points users to registry/package discovery for public artifacts.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current build-scope source already supports the requested query model, and adding new DomainResource or local explanatory prose would be redundant rather than a necessary semantic correction.
